user_prompt: We need to orchestrate the launch of our new product line, ensuring that procurement sources quality raw materials that meet our standards, engineering designs and validates the components, operations sets up manufacturing processes, and sales prepares go-to-market strategies. As we ramp up production, we'll also need to seamlessly integrate with our systems to retrieve and manage incoming customer orders and account information for processing. Additionally, the process should include coordinating any engineering modifications and material lifecycle changes across departments to keep everything synchronized. Can you help us design a workflow that handles all of these moving parts together?

method_trace.picked_reason: This agent orchestrates product change coordination and inventory synchronization across departments. It monitors engineering changes and material updates to trigger coordinated workflows, processes product item transitions through lifecycle stages, and coordinates automated communication across affected segments. It directly addresses the need to coordinate procurement sourcing, engineering design/validation, operations manufacturing setup, and sales go-to-market strategies while synchronizing engineering modifications and material lifecycle changes across the entire organization. The agent's multi-department coordination capability makes it ideal for managing all moving parts of the product launch workflow together.
